name: labs/aaronslaff__tecan_fluentcontrol
title: Tecan FluentControl liquid handler (fluent_control_automation.FluentControlClient)
intro: Tecan FluentControl liquid handler (fluent_control_automation.FluentControlClient), adapted from aaronslaff/tecan_fluentcontrol. It reads `instrument_status`, `deck_layout` and `transfer_status`; runs `post_transfer_session`, `start_transfer_session`, `get_transfer_status`, `cancel_transfer_session` and 1 more. `post_transfer_session`: post one source-to-destination transfer and create a transfer session. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
